paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is 2.65, with a change of -7.34% compared to the prior close and -45.02% over a window of 22 sessions. The price is as of October 22, 2026.

Recent news includes a letter to shareholders from Fermi CEO Lee McIntire outlining a capital strategy for Project Matador, as reported by Seeking Alpha on October 21, 2026. Other news includes the stock hitting a 52-week low at 2.99 USD, reported by Investing.com Australia on October 20, 2026, and a surge of 14% on October 13, 2026, due to AMD's credit support for Project Matador, as reported by The Motley Fool.

There have been recent filings, including a Form 4 filed on October 23, 2026, and a Form 144 filed on October 21, 2026. An 8-K form was filed on October 16, 2026, announcing an amendment to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement with MUFG Bank, Ltd. Insider transactions and notices of proposed sales have also been reported in recent filings.
